caption: The drawing depicts a dark-colored ceramic vessel with a rounded body, a narrow base, and a single handle attached to its upper right side. The vessel is placed on a shallow, circular saucer, which appears slightly larger in diameter than the base of the vessel. Both objects are rendered in grayscale tones, with shading applied to indicate highlights and shadows, giving them a three-dimensional appearance. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, rectangular inset showing a close-up of the top view of the same or a similar vessel, also in grayscale, with two small protruding elements on opposite sides. The drawing is signed "JANET RIZA" in the lower right corner within the main frame. The background is blank except for the faint outline of the framing rectangles.
title: Grease Lamp
